name: bushes_understory

spec_choice.reason: The doc §3 literal 3-layer stack (block + bush2 + fern1, i.e. 2 sprites) cannot pass C3 (>=3 silhouettes). The canonical spec applies the doc's own §3 density pass: 10 sprites with the weighted family mix (bush 40%, fern 30%, plantain 20%, flower 10% here; port pool is 33/33/21/12.5), cross-mixed hash positions and flower shrink 0.75x. The literal base stack was rendered to a temp dir and measured for contrast.

scale_convention.doc: scale_range [0.55,0.95] is in the doc's own 512px-sprite convention and yields overlapping full-width clumps on the renderer canvas
scale_convention.note: applied factor 0.28 to each doc scale so a clump is ~30-60px tall and 10 sprites do not merge into one blob

density.placement: seed-7 hash jitter, both axes mixed; reject candidate if pairwise centroid distance < 0.06 tile or if it forms an axis-aligned row with two existing clumps

black_backing_note: fern*/flower*/plantain* PNGs carry 40-68% opaque pure-black backing. The renderer has no alpha-keying step, so criterion C5 is expected to FAIL. No donor/repo asset was modified to key it out.

reference.role: scattered white-flowering bushes + isolated tall tufts, no rows; renderer comparison tile only

primary.note: scattered white-flowering bushes + isolated tall tufts, no rows

v2_note: luminance-gated +B PROXY: lifts only lit decor (L>13), leaves opaque black backing black so C5 remains an honest failure; asset rebake still required
